gradient_estimate_assumption: All trainable parameters receive dense fp32 gradients; explicit training configuration, not observed gradients.

script_scan.limitations: Candidates may be unused, overridden, or in inactive branches. External configs, CLI overrides and dynamic values need explicit input.

still_required: Input shapes/sequence lengths, padding/packing policy and task/loss.
Optimizer-specific future state shapes/dtypes if not initialized.
Explicit master-copy policy; not reliably discoverable across frameworks.
Activation/workspace estimator matching architecture and kernels.
Target GPU capacity, precision-specific compute and bandwidth.
Runtime model: operation counts, utilization assumptions, data loading, evaluation/checkpoint overhead and distributed communication.
limitations: Collection runs no training or benchmark; observed memory is not peak memory.
Before backward/step, missing gradients and optimizer states are not zero-cost.
Observed storage is current-device storage, not target GPU memory.
Meta tensors have logical sizes but no allocated storage.
Quantization metadata, sparse storage, offload and distributed sharding require specialized handling; logical sizes are not sufficient.
Parameter counts deduplicate shared Parameter objects, but distinct Parameter views can still overlap storage.
Optimizer-exposed master tensors may already appear in optimizer_states; global observed storage is deduplicated.
No runtime or peak-memory prediction is invented for unsupported setups.

configured_optimizer.name: AdamW
configured_optimizer.note: User configuration only. Future optimizer tensors are not initialized.

provenance.settings_policy: Only explicit training config is confirmed. AST candidates are not automatically promoted to settings.
